title: fix(workboard): board totals shrink while cards are paginated
body:
## What Problem This Solves
Workboard's board picker replaces authoritative full-store summaries with counts of only the loaded100-card page, making larger boards appear smaller and unseen boards appear empty.

## Solution
Preserve server summaries while a continuation exists; retain complete-list local-edit recomputation and observed counts for unsummarized boards. Credit @AmelioMansour.

## Evidence
[Built Gateway and styled Control UI, real Chromium,175 real RPC-created cards, inspected screenshots](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181164#issuecomment-6513626511).

Main twice: first page Default100/100 and Operations0/0; after Load more149/150 and25/25. Candidate twice:149/150 and25/25 before and after Load more. Archived-card exclusion and complete-window behavior unchanged. Focused owner test and formatting pass. Existing owner coverage now exercises complete/incomplete windows; new fixture browser scaffolding removed in favor of real product proof; tests net0.

[Latest-main integration proof](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181164#issuecomment-6514712715): merged main `315380c4789590e3aff9be3cfc6fcfcb9e1f6eee`, rebuilt both snapshots, and repeated the real pagination scenario once each. Main still fails; merged head `462800d2bc5ee3a920434e593a94f81075cb0574` preserves correct totals. Fresh inspected screenshot pair attached there.

## Merge risk
Two-way door: revert restores earlier display counting, no data migration. Blast radius Workboard board-picker descriptions; Gateway RPCs, storage and SDK unchanged.
